icon:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original plugin app icon and 1024x1024 avatar.
Primary request: Create a single polished professional square icon for "Checkout Blocker for WooCommerce by Talistech". Original symbol, no official WooCommerce or WordPress logos. Show a clean, immediately readable off-white shopping cart with two wheels and a bold circular stop/block badge seamlessly integrated at its upper right: badge contains one simple horizontal minus, not an X or padlock. One unmistakable idea, checkout restriction, readable at 32px.
Style: extremely crisp flat geometric brand artwork, solid forms, restrained premium software identity. No letters, no text, no border, no photographs, no shadows, no 3D.
Color palette: uniform full-bleed dark midnight teal #142633 background, off-white #F4F7F6 shopping cart, emerald #147363 restriction badge with white minus; a tiny cyan #22AED1 accent is optional only if it improves recognition. Strong white cart contrast.
Composition: exactly square 1024x1024. Single large centered symbol occupying about 66 percent of width, optically balanced, ample outer padding for circular avatar crops. Full background extends to all four edges, no baked rounded app-square corners. Flat even lighting, no texture. Avoid fine details, tiny linework, gradients, extra shields, decorative elements or watermarks.
Deliver one icon only, not a sheet or mockup.
